title: Find the Magic Number
statement:
You are given a sorted array of N distinct integers. Your task is to find the index (1-based) of a target integer X in the array. If the target integer is not present in the array, output -1.

You must solve this in O(log N) time complexity.
input_format:
The first line contains two space-separated integers, N and X, representing the size of the array and the target number.
The second line contains N space-separated integers, A[1], A[2], ..., A[N].
output_format: Print a single integer: the 1-based index of X in the array, or -1 if it is not found.
